summary: One medium missing-link finding: the accepted map delegates the QuiverRepresentations Layer 3 -> Zigzag Layer 3 prerequisite to a partial, unreviewed sibling packet, so it never enters the production graph. All 13 actual links, seven overlap recommendations and 42 verbatim quotations survive this audit. The finding concerns dependency integration, not absence of the projective-cover mathematics from the pinned library.
checked: Independent worker Codex — codex-rtOQ9t, neither original author ChatGPT Pro — cgp-0d58f52c658d nor accepting reviewer Codex — codex-7e92bd. Read the complete issue after bot confirmation of claim comment 5911256790. Base 75003a68838084dc3b0cfec12fd5064e3ca21be4, accessed 2026-09-30.

Read the focal README, all nine focal stages, the 15 distinct external link/overlap endpoints, the original handoff and independent review. Checked all 13 link directions and seven keep/rescope recommendations; all 42 evidence quotations match both raw source files and their stated line ranges.

Checked path-product handedness, finite vertex versus finite path hypotheses, isolated-vertex generators, generic quotient-module restriction, projective/simple Cartan transpose, split/basic hypotheses, cohomological and internal finite support, and finite versus possibly infinite linear resolutions. The inherited R-PATH, R-BOUND, R-CARTAN and R-KOSZUL qualifications remain necessary; they are not presented as new discoveries.

Checked finite numbered ADE versus affine semidefinite diagrams and the affine A1 double-edge exception; A1 dual numbers and A2 cubic relations versus the higher-rank quadratic definition; relative S=k^I duality, opposite conventions, signless versus signed preprojective relations, bipartite rescaling and characteristic-two collapse.

Checked actual contraction/splitting requirements, normalized arity-complete Hochschild cochains, arbitrary-characteristic braces versus rational exponential gauge, HH regrading, minimal deformation versus transfer versus intrinsic formality, ordinary versus completed Koszul duality, Pi2 versus Gamma3 degrees, smooth/left versus proper/right CY, negative-cyclic lifts, and supplied-equivalence transport versus constructing McKay equivalences or proving faithfulness.

Fresh library-coverage lookup gives no reviewed entries for the nine focal stages; AUDIT-44.json is an assignment, not coverage. Read pinned Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369 path-algebra carrier/basis/product/idempotent/unit statements; IsProjectiveCover and exists_isProjectiveCover_of_finiteDimensional; zigzagProjective, its grading and zigzagProjective_projective; DynkinType and its Cartan matrix; AffineDynkinType.cartanMatrix and its IsGraphical comparison. Read Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 TwoSidedIdeal.asIdeal and its IsTwoSided instance. Do not infer library absence from the old roadmap prose or from absent audit coverage.

Fetched and read Liu–Wang arXiv:2301.06757v3, Theorem 1.1, Corollary 3.4 and sections 4.1–4.4 including Definition 4.3, Proposition 4.4 and Remark 4.5, plus Huerfano–Khovanov arXiv:math/0002060v2 section 6.3 around Propositions 16–18. Confirmed the tree/characteristic, completion and binary-versus-odd-cyclic boundaries. These are selected source checks, not a proof audit of every focal reference.

Screened all 212 raw snapshot roadmaps/1968 stages and the assembled 211 roadmaps/2840 stages, nine new-roadmap definitions, 143 research packets, 51 decompositions and reserved IDs. A narrower Koszul/Hochschild/Frobenius-algebra/braid/graded-Cartan/quotient search returned 41 assembled roadmap candidates. Inspected the closest interfaces in StablePeriodicCurved, RootSystems, GeometricTopology, ArithmeticQuantumTopology, RefinedTraceMethods, DerivedDeRhamCohomology, EnhancedDerivedSheaves and the inverse-Galois/Belyi braid usages. Keyword matches in arithmetic Frobenius, Hochschild–Serre or commutative Koszul-completion work do not supply the graph-algebra interfaces.

No existing McKay roadmap/consumer endpoint was found in the current snapshot, new definitions or assembled atlas. Generic stable-category machinery does not depend on its zigzag example; ribbon/Hurwitz braid actions do not prove the graph bimodule relations; commutative derived completion is not the noncommutative length completion; cyclic chains do not alone supply the normalized Hochschild cochain obstruction theorem. No additional direct link was established from these candidates.

Built the production atlas in memory: 2840 stages, 8007 directed pairs. All 13 focal links occur as edges and consumer requires. The reused Quiver3 -> Zigzag3 pair occurs in neither place; there is no forward or reverse path. Its sibling packet is partial, has no review and has no data/links copy. A local-only diagnostic passes the candidate through merge_links with a copied diagnostic acceptance marker: 8008 pairs, still 8008 after a repeated merge, correct requires and no cycle. This marker is not independent acceptance and was never written to production data.

Rechecked the isolated-vertex F3 x F3 counterexample to arrow-only generation and the nonsymmetric 1 -> 2 Cartan transpose. The dual-numbers Cartan matrix [2] also prevents unconditional unimodularity; infinite simple resolutions prevent an unconditional finite Ext-Euler sum. These support existing qualifications rather than additional findings.

Validation: check_links on the unchanged accepted map reports zero errors/warnings; check_redteam, intake check-files for the two deliverables and git diff --check pass. This job supplies no Lean file. No Lean compilation, library build, generated atlas mutation or full axiom audit was performed.

findings.claim: The accepted complete map omits its acknowledged primitive-idempotent/projective-cover/ordinary-Cartan dependency from executable links because the pair is present in a sibling research packet. That sibling remains partial and unreviewed, so the dependency is absent from the production graph and from the consumer's requires. There is no indirect dependency path either. This is a bounded completeness/integration gap; alreadyRecorded accurately records the research-file occurrence but does not make it an integrated prerequisite.
findings.evidence: At base 75003a68838084dc3b0cfec12fd5064e3ca21be4, the QuiverRepresentations packet has status=partial, no review, and no data/links counterpart. Its Layer 3 README, lines 288–291, says 'Build `projectiveCover M`: a projective `P` with an' essential epimorphism, unique up to isomorphism. Zigzag Layer 3 says 'Define the indecomposable graded left projective `P_i = Z e_i`, its simple head, socle, radical' and then requires comparison with the bound-quiver/module interface; the accepted link-map alreadyRecorded entry itself confirms this ordinary input. scripts/build.py loads data/links and scripts/decompositions.py:merge_links consumes links, not alreadyRecorded. Production assembly has all 13 recorded focal edges but no Quiver3 -> Zigzag3 edge, requires entry or directed path. Pinned Tau Ceti ProjectiveCover/Basic.lean:105–111 and Existence.lean:194–201 already provide the cover predicate and finite-dimensional existence theorem, while Quiver/Zigzag/Projective/Basic.lean:145–148 supplies projectivity of Z e_i. The dependency should reuse these results, not re-plan them.
